title: Citebase tool call
description: Runs one Citebase tool and returns its result. An AI assistant normally fills this in. For a live MCP connection use the Standby URL instead.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Which Citebase tool to run, for example 'get_playbook'. Start with get_playbook and arguments {} to list the guidelines, then read 'start'. Required. NOT an Apify Actor name.

arguments.title: Tool arguments (JSON)
arguments.description: Inputs for the chosen tool as a JSON object. get_playbook {name?} e.g. {"name":"start"}. audit_site {url, max_pages?} e.g. {"url":"https://example.com"}. quote_cost {items:[{job,units,requests?}]} e.g. {"items":[{"job":"serp_page","units":15}]}. measure_recommendation_share {panel,runs,baseline?,current?,experiments?}. next_steps {audit?,report?,max_steps?}. check_outreach_draft {to,subject,body,suppressed?,sent_today?,daily_cap?}. Free tools; no credentials here. Defaults to {}.
